methodology: Identical chronological inputs, training excluded. Raw baseline ranks by severity and selects severity >= threshold; time baseline groups by scenario/host with inactivity timeout. Pipeline decisions use online priority. Coverage is any selected review signal in [start,end), not proof of technique detection. Latency is from window start to first selected signal; misses excluded from latency and reported separately. Review units are a workload proxy, not measured human time. Benign rates use only explicitly reviewed cases and sampled reference intersection; no population false-positive rate is claimed. Suppressions disabled for reproducibility.

score.definition: Percentage of labeled attack windows with an operational technique-specific signal. All labeled windows are included; this is detection coverage, not record-level accuracy.

pipeline_technique_coverage.note: Labels describe time windows, not individual malicious records. Specific signals, generic anomalies, training-only evidence and missing telemetry are reported separately. This is not precision, recall or proof of success. Intervals are [start, end).
pipeline_technique_coverage.isolation: Read only after replay completion. Frozen classifications and groups are unchanged.
